prompt.subject: one tiny SD chibi baby dragon Ringpet, full-body front view, mostly symmetrical rig-friendly pose; head faces forward, eyes visible and cute, small snout, neutral happy mouth; arms slightly away from torso with open little claws; wings spread behind but separated from the body silhouette; legs and feet visible; curled tail visible around the lower body without covering the belly

prompt.ringpet_identity: prominent glowing cyan-gold resonance ring collar around the neck/shoulders, clear circular ring-core gem on the chest, small circular resonance accents on cheeks/body, egg-hatched magical companion read
prompt.style: polished 2D Korean anime game mascot art, clean cel-shaded SD creature, crisp readable silhouette, high-quality front model sheet feeling

prompt.constraints: no flame, no fireball, no held fire, no rear view, no side view, no giant portrait crop, no complex overlapping effects, no extra characters, no UI frame, no text, no watermark
